declarations.name: SheetpaneExcel
declarations.summary: `<sheetpane-excel>` — the sheet: views and edits a `.xlsx` or `.csv` file held in the pane's in-memory workbook (SR-GRID decisions 9–22e).
declarations.description:
`<sheetpane-excel>` — the sheet: views and edits a `.xlsx` or `.csv` file held in the pane's in-memory workbook (SR-GRID decisions 9–22e). Every change stays in memory and `export()` writes a copy of the upload with it (SR-LAW-6); a `<sheetpane-errors>` on the same `pane` reads the same store, so the two are always in step (SR-LAW-7). It registers on import.

See SR-GRID: https://github.com/arpitarya/sheetpane/blob/main/records/0105_GRID.md

attributes.name: pane
attributes.description: The pane id shared with other elements; none gives the element its own store.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: A URL (read with a GET; nothing is sent), a data URL or base64.

attributes.name: display
attributes.description: `tab` (the default) or `popup` (a modal dialog, shown by `open`).

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Written into the errors this element's user flags.

attributes.name: plugins
attributes.description: Space-separated registered plugin ids; fixed per pane.

attributes.name: on-invalid
attributes.description: `flag` (the default) or `block`: what a failing column rule does.

attributes.name: rules-src
attributes.description: A URL to a rules file (read with a GET).

attributes.name: flagging
attributes.description: `on` (the default) or `off`: no Flag issue anywhere.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: The cell or range selected once a file is read, scrolled into view: `B4`, `Data!B4`, `'Q3 data'!B4:D8`; setting it later selects it then. One that names no cell is warned (SP-3016) and the sheet opens at A1. React, Vue and Solid keep `ref` for their own refs — set it with `setAttribute`.

attributes.name: link
attributes.description: `none` (the default) or `hash`: the selection is kept in the URL fragment as `#sheetpane=<pane>:<Sheet>!<ref>`, read when a file is read and on back and forward, and *Copy link* joins the cell menu. The rest of the fragment is the host's and is kept as it was.

members.name: workbook
members.description: The pane's store; assigning one replaces the `pane` lookup and applies this element's `mode` to it.

members.name: errors
members.description: A copy of the pane's errors; assigning restores a saved review, like `setErrors()`.

members.name: errorTypes
members.description: The types offered in the Flag issue form; an empty list falls back to `DEFAULT_ERROR_TYPES`.

members.name: file
members.description: Loads a file, like `load()`; `null` does nothing.

members.name: mode
members.description: The pane's mode, `view` or `edit`; setting it sets the `mode` attribute.

members.name: theme
members.description: `light` (the default), `dark`, or `auto` (follows `prefers-color-scheme`) — colour only; the file's own colours never change (W-29).

members.name: rules
members.description: A rules file (W-33) as an object: `{ version: 1, sheets: { "*": …, "Accounts": { headerRow, columns, cells } } }`. Also `rules-src`.

members.name: flagging
members.description: `flagging="off"`: no Flag issue anywhere, no composer, no callout card — the errors panel is the one place errors are read.

members.name: columns
members.description: Rules by column title, as plain JSON (`required`, `type`, `min`, `max`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `pattern`, `oneOf`, `unique`, `message`, `severity`, `onInvalid`).

members.name: validate
members.description: `validate(ctx, signal)`, sync or async: `null`, or `{ severity, message, expected? }`.

members.name: onInvalid
members.description: The default for every rule: `flag` (store and add an error) or `block` (refuse the value). Also the `on-invalid` attribute.

members.name: open
members.description: Whether the pop-up is shown (the `open` attribute).

members.name: sizes

type.text: Record<string, { cols: Record<string, number>; rows: Record<string, number> }>

members.description:
The column widths and row heights a user set, px at 100 % zoom: `{ [sheet]: { cols: { B: 120 }, rows: { 4: 40 } } }`
(columns by letter, rows by number). A view setting like zoom — not a change, not undone, not in the
download; a new file clears it. Set it to restore what a host saved from `sheetpane-resize` (W-47).

members.name: src
members.description: The `src` attribute; `null`, `undefined` or `''` removes it.

members.name: ref
members.description: The `ref` attribute: the cell or range selected once a file is read (W-66); `null`, `undefined` or `''` removes it.

members.name: link
members.description: `none` (the default) or `hash`: the selection kept in the URL fragment, and *Copy link* in the cell menu (W-66).

members.name: load
members.description: Reads a file into the pane: a File, Blob, bytes, a URL, or base64.

members.name: export
members.description: Every change applied; the upload untouched. Also dispatches `sheetpane-export`.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects a cell and scrolls to it.

members.name: getErrors
members.description: A copy of the pane's errors, to save a review.

members.name: setErrors
members.description: Restores a saved review; not a user action, so the undo stack is cleared.

members.name: highlight
clearHighlight
members.description: Removes the outline `highlight()` drew (W-56).

members.name: undo
members.description: Undoes the pane's last step.

members.name: redo
members.description: Redoes the last undone step.

members.name: column
members.description: The column a payload names: index, letter and the title from the header row (`header-row`, default 1).

type.text: { index: number; letter: string; header: string }

members.name: shortcuts
members.description: The grid's keys, then every plugin control's shortcut (W-14 DoD 8).

members.name: reveal
unreveal
members.description:
Hides again what this element revealed for viewing on a sheet (W-49).
@param sheet - The sheet's name.

members.name: renderNow
members.description: Renders now (tests and the first frame).

members.name: geometryFor
members.description: Geometry as plugins see it: pixels at 100 % zoom from A1's top-left.

events.name: sheetpane-load

type.text: CustomEvent<{ status: 'ready'; name: string; kind: 'xlsx' | 'csv'; sheets: string[]; readMs: number } | { status: 'error'; code: string; spCode: SpCode; message: string; name: string; detail?: string }>

events.description: `{ status: 'ready', name, kind, sheets, readMs }` when a file is read, or the refusal `{ status: 'error', code, spCode, message, name, detail? }`.

events.name: sheetpane-change

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; kind: ChangeKind; was: unknown; now: unknown; op?: 'insertRows' | 'deleteRows' | 'insertCols' | 'deleteCols'; at?: number; count?: number }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, kind, was, now, op?, at?, count? }` for each change, undo and redo included; rows or columns inserted or deleted (W-52) are one event, `kind: 'structure'`, with `op`, `at` (0-based) and `count`.

events.name: sheetpane-errors
events.description: `{ errors, plugins }` when the pane's errors change.

events.name: sheetpane-select

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; range: string | undefined; column: { index: number; letter: string; header: string }; value: unknown }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, range, column, value }` when the selection settles — `range` (`B3:D8`) when more than one cell is selected; a drag fires once, on release.

events.name: sheetpane-visibility

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; axis: 'row' | 'col' | 'sheet'; indexes: number[]; hidden: boolean; via: 'menu' | 'key' | 'marker' | 'reveal' }>

events.description: `{ sheet, axis, indexes, hidden, via }` when rows, columns or a sheet are hidden, unhidden or shown for viewing (`via: 'reveal'`) (W-49).

events.name: sheetpane-resize

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; axis: 'col' | 'row'; indexes: number[]; px: number | number[]; via: 'drag' | 'fit' | 'menu' | 'reset' }>

events.description: `{ sheet, axis, indexes, px, via }` when a column width or row height is set by a drag, a fit, the header menu or a reset — on release, never during a drag (W-47).

events.name: sheetpane-hover

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; column: { index: number; letter: string; header: string } } | null>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, column }` when a mouse or pen pointer moves onto another cell (a merge's top-left), at most once per frame, or `null` when it leaves the cells; never for a finger (W-56).

events.name: sheetpane-sheet
events.description: `{ sheet }` when the selection moves to another sheet.

events.name: sheetpane-mode
events.description: `{ mode }` when the pane switches between View and Edit.

events.name: sheetpane-history

type.text: CustomEvent<{ reason: 'undo' | 'redo' | 'cleared'; canUndo: boolean; canRedo: boolean }>

events.description: `{ reason, canUndo, canRedo }` on undo, redo, or the stack cleared by `setErrors()`.

events.name: sheetpane-editstart

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; column: { index: number; letter: string; header: string }; value: unknown }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, column, value }` before a cell edit starts; cancellable — the cell stays read-only.

events.name: sheetpane-input

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; column: { index: number; letter: string; header: string }; draft: string; was: unknown }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, column, draft, was }` as the cell-bar draft is typed.

events.name: sheetpane-beforechange

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string; column: { index: number; letter: string; header: string }; was: unknown; now: unknown }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref, column, was, now }` before a value is stored; cancellable — the value is refused.

events.name: sheetpane-editcancel

type.text: CustomEvent<{ sheet: string; ref: string } | { sheet: string; ref: string; reason: 'blocked'; code: 'SP-6003'; message: string }>

events.description: `{ sheet, ref }` when Esc restores a draft, or `{ sheet, ref, reason: 'blocked', code: 'SP-6003', message }` when a `block` rule refuses it.

events.name: sheetpane-export

type.text: CustomEvent<{ blob: Blob; kind: 'xlsx' | 'csv'; name: string; guarded: string[] | false; format: 'xlsx' | 'csv'; converted: boolean; original?: boolean }>

events.description: `{ blob, kind, name, guarded, format, converted, original? }` on `export()` and Download; cancellable — the Download control then saves nothing.

events.name: sheetpane-close
events.description: `{}` when the pop-up closes.

slots.description: Host controls for the format row (Edit only); the row shows when a plugin or this slot puts something in it.

declarations.name: SheetpaneErrors
declarations.summary: `<sheetpane-errors>` — the error list and the Flag issue form, on the same in-memory workbook as `<sheetpane-excel>` (SR-ERRORS).
declarations.description:
`<sheetpane-errors>` — the error list and the Flag issue form, on the same in-memory workbook as `<sheetpane-excel>` (SR-ERRORS). It keeps no private copy: every render reads the pane's store, so the two are always in step (SR-LAW-7). It registers on import.

See SR-ERRORS: https://github.com/arpitarya/sheetpane/blob/main/records/0106_ERRORS.md

attributes.name: pane
attributes.description: The pane id shared with the sheet; none gives the element its own store.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Hides the form, Resolve, Delete, Undo and Redo (a sign-off screen).

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Written into the errors this element's user adds.

attributes.name: plugins
attributes.description: Space-separated registered plugin ids; fixed per pane.

members.name: workbook
members.description: The pane's store; assigning one replaces the `pane` lookup.

members.name: errors
members.description: A copy of the pane's errors; assigning restores a saved review, like `setErrors()`.

members.name: errorTypes
members.description: The types offered in the form; an empty list falls back to `DEFAULT_ERROR_TYPES`.

members.name: readOnly
members.description: Whether the list is read-only (the `readonly` attribute).

members.name: theme
members.description: `light` (the default), `dark` or `auto` — the same tokens as the sheet (W-29).

members.name: getErrors
members.description: A copy of the pane's errors, to save a review.

members.name: setErrors
members.description: Restores a saved review. `plugins` (from the saved `sheetpane-errors` envelope) shows a notice when it differs from this pane's set.

members.name: renderNow
members.description: Renders now (tests and the first frame).

events.name: sheetpane-reveal
events.description: `{ error }` on Show in sheet, so the host can switch tab or open the pop-up.
